answer: The ledger escrows young accounts' rewards (e.g. fees for lagoon water-quality checks) and vests them over 10 days plus 1 day per 40 newcomers network-wide. Adding 400 farm keys stretches every key's lock to 20 days, so each next key freezes more capital for longer. Time cannot be split, shared or rewound. A fraud proof, e.g. river gauge data copied from a glacier archive, burns all unvested escrow.
